articles.title: Ondo drops tokenized asset blockchain plans for private, high-speed trading network
articles.description: The new network powers Ondo's recently-launched perpetual futures platform and will eventually support trading across onchain financial assets.

articles.title: Ozlo’s Sleepbuds 2 build on Bose’s sleep earbud legacy
articles.description: Ozlo’s first major update to its sleep earbuds introduces longer battery life, improved connectivity, enhanced audio, and new sleep features as the startup continues the product line once abandoned by Bose.

articles.title: The robot NASA hired to lift a orbital telescope is tumbling out of control
articles.description: According to NASA, two of the three reaction wheels that control the spacecraft's alignment have failed, and there are problems with one of the spacecraft's thruster systems.

articles.title: Waymo, robotaxi operators face fresh scrutiny over emergency response failures
articles.description: Rep. Kevin Mullin (D-California ) has proposed a bill that would direct federal regulators to establish minimum national safety standards for autonomous vehicle operators.

articles.title: AmericanFortress proposes quantum-safe crypto wallet protection without fund migration
articles.description: The proposed cryptographic scheme aims to protect existing Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana wallets from future quantum attacks without requiring users to move funds or change wallet addresses.

articles.title: These App Store hidden gems prove there’s still room for great software in the AI era
articles.description: Despite predictions that AI agents could make traditional apps obsolete, developers are shipping new software faster than ever. From smarter bookmarking tools and neighborhood marketplaces to digital pen pals and nature journals, here are the latest App Store finds worth adding to your Home Screen.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Galaxy, MARA Holdings deepen Texas expansion with land acquisitions
articles.description: The crypto-focused companies announced separate acquisitions as demand for power-intensive AI and digital infrastructure continues to grow.

articles.title: HBO Max embraces vertical video with a new ‘Shorts’ feed
articles.description: HBO Max, like other streaming platforms, is rethinking content discovery as large libraries are making it hard for viewers to find something to watch and as audiences become accustomed to short-form content on platforms like TikTok and Instagram Reels.

articles.title: Wall Street veteran Don Wilson says regulators are getting perps all wrong
articles.description: DRW CEO Don Wilson says perpetual futures aren't inherently risky crypto gambling tools, and it’s time traditional markets and regulators start embracing them.

articles.title: Bitcoin lows pierce $63K as Asia chip-stock crash spreads to Wall Street
articles.description: Bitcoin and crypto dropped as contagion from a major Asia stock-market correction spreads to the US at the Wall Street open.

articles.title: Kraken opens Jersey Mike’s IPO to retail investors through tokenized shares and direct allocations
articles.description: Eligible US users can request IPO allocations, while customers in more than 110 countries gain access to tokenized Jersey Mike’s shares backed 1:1 by the underlying stock.

articles.title: BlackRock, Fidelity, other Wall Street giants back the Clarity Act
articles.description: BlackRock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, Goldman Sachs and SoFi have publicly endorsed the crypto market structure bill as the Senate's timeline tightens.

articles.title: Core Scientific revenue doubles in Q2 as AI colocation expansion accelerates
articles.description: Core Scientific reported strong second-quarter revenue growth as AI colocation became its largest business, though a non-cash accounting charge resulted in a $1.15 billion net loss.

articles.title: Ethereum startup EthSystems bets privacy is key to getting banks on public blockchains
articles.description: EthSystems, which spun out of the Ethereum Foundation earlier this month, is focused on building privacy infrastructure for banks and other financial institutions.

articles.title: PayPal leaves the door open to a higher takeover offer following earnings beat
articles.description: After reporting better-than-expected Q2 results, PayPal said it remains focused on its AI-driven turnaround, but would consider a deal that creates more value for shareholders.

articles.title: Elon Musk’s X Money app is rolling out in the US
articles.description: Users get an X Visa debit card, which they can immediately add to Apple Pay and use to make instant peer-to-peer transfers within the app without fees or limits.

articles.title: Russia outlines new digital depository rules ahead of fall crypto framework roll-out
articles.description: The central bank's draft rules require digital asset platforms to hold up to $2.8 million in liquid capital as a sweeping regulatory framework looms.

articles.title: Hyperliquid is taking crypto perps deep into DeFi’s ‘money LEGO’ land
articles.description: Hyperliquid is capitalizing on the volume and depth of its order book by giving firms the option to compose with the platform’s shared liquidity, rather than fragmenting it.

articles.title: Zcash seals $1.7 billion shielded pool as Ironwood upgrade activates
articles.description: The upgrade retires Orchard, where a counterfeiting bug sat undetected for four years. Every coin inside now has to leave through a gate that caps withdrawals at verified deposits.
